header.title: Andrej Dunaev
header.subtitle: Energy Infrastructure Engineer & Engineering Coordination and Project Delivery
header.description: For more than 20 years, I have worked on the design and delivery of energy infrastructure projects. I combine engineering coordination, technical documentation, and vendor collaboration, using automation and AI to improve process transparency and reliability.

about.p1: I am an energy infrastructure engineer with more than 20 years of experience in main gas pipeline, compressor station, industrial site facility, and underground gas storage projects.
about.p2: For more than nine years, I worked on the design of pipeline systems and industrial facilities. My work then expanded to coordinating and overseeing the development of FEED and detailed design documentation, supporting construction and operations, preparing RFQs, coordinating with vendors, and managing change.
about.p3: My strength is maintaining alignment among engineering decisions, documentation, and project participants’ actions. I support decision traceability, visibility into work status, and reliable information exchange among clients, design institutes, contractors, vendors, procurement, and operations.
about.p4: On my own initiative, I systematically develop automation within my engineering and documentation workflows. I use Python, AI agents, and reusable agentic workflows to search and analyze documentation, prepare reports, track action items, and process technical data wherever confidentiality requirements permit. I preserve result traceability and the ability to perform engineering review: automation strengthens expertise but does not replace engineering judgment.

delivery.title: Engineering Coordination and Project Delivery

coordination.title: Project Coordination

comita.title: Chief Engineering Expert (Planning, Monitoring & Reporting)
description: Coordinate engineering activities, project monitoring, reporting, RFQ documentation, vendor communication, and follow-up control for energy infrastructure projects.
Connect clients, design institutes, subcontractors, vendors, and internal teams through structured documentation, planning discipline, and reliable reporting.
Prepare and coordinate RFQ packages, support technical clarifications, review vendor inputs, and monitor open issues through closure.
Developed a Python/Django-based internal system for meeting protocols, issue tracking, action item control, task filtering by organization, discussion history, and automated XLSX reporting.
Built tools for maintenance report processing, documentation package preparation, file sorting, Excel-template population, archive generation, and structured logging.

idc-2.title: Chief Engineering Expert (Project Management)
description: Provided comprehensive technical support for project and operational documentation, including pre-commissioning for main gas pipelines and compressor stations.
Reviewed subcontractor reports, maintained statistics on recurring maintenance issues, and automated comment sheet generation with Python.
Developed Python-based graphical tools for big data trend analysis and equipment status monitoring; trained colleagues to use them.
Created detailed equipment maintenance checklists based on manufacturer documentation.
Prepared analytical data and technical conclusions for EPC contract documentation to resolve disputes.
Produced ~120 visual analytical reports comparing design documentation with as-built conditions for claims and counterclaims.
Updated ~350 as-built documents, including mechanical drawings, electrical diagrams, instrumentation, automation tables, and settings after identifying discrepancies.

idc-1.title: Chief Engineering Expert (Execution)
description: Coordinated realization of 400km main gas pipeline and compressor station construction.
Oversaw finalization of FEED, Detailed Design, and As-built documentation.
Managed coordination between design institutes (Saipem, Giprogazcentr, etc.), processing approximately 20,000 documents across disciplines.
Implemented MDR/MDI procedures for automated data storage through indexing and data structuring.
Coordinated RFQ processes, procurement packages, and vendor relations to ensure manufacturers understood project requirements.
Participated in HAZOP reviews and ensured compliance with PED, ATEX, Ex, and CE standards (including equipment certification preparation).

gazprom.title: Junior Project Coordinator
description: Coordinated a portfolio of 8+ major infrastructure projects valued from $30M to $23B.
Improved budget forecast accuracy by 5-10% through validated cost estimates.
Reduced project implementation delay risks by 5-10% through early identification of technical and organizational risks.
Facilitated ~250 stakeholder meetings with a 93-95% action item completion rate based on protocol metrics.

kuban.title: Lead Design Engineer
description: Participated in establishing a new core department for main pipeline design.
Conducted technical expertise of design solutions for cost optimization.
Provided technical support to customer inspectors.

yuzh-1.title: Lead Design Engineer
description: Worked on projects like 'South Stream' and 'Bovanenkovo — Ukhta'.
Implemented 3D design solutions that increased productivity by 50% in terms of design preparation and approval time.
Optimized design processes by integrating Excel, AutoCAD, and SolidWorks.
Designed pig receiving/launching traps and valve stations in SolidWorks.

skills.title: Skills & Data
skills.description: My expertise lies at the intersection of <0>Engineering Coordination</0>, <1>Technical Documentation</1>, and <2>Data Automation</2>. The interactive graph below shows how these fields connect in my daily work — from RFQ and vendor documentation to issue tracking, reporting, and AI-assisted tools.

engineering-process-management-system.title: Internal Engineering Process Management System
engineering-process-management-system.description: An internal Python/Django system for meeting protocols, issue tracking, action item control, task filtering by organization, discussion history, and automated XLSX reporting.
engineering-process-management-system.impact: Improves traceability of decisions and responsibilities while reducing missed actions and repetitive reporting work.

auto-comment-sheets.title: TOiR Reporting Automation
auto-comment-sheets.description: A Python-based automation tool for preparing technical reports, index folders, and transmittals. It handles automated Excel template filling, grouping of project documentation, and ZIP archive creation, optimizing complex engineering workflows and reducing routine task time from minutes to seconds.
auto-comment-sheets.impact: Reduces report and transmittal preparation from minutes to seconds.

pipeline-analytics.title: TOiR Documentation Dispatcher
pipeline-analytics.description: An intelligent Python utility for automatically distributing incoming project PDF reports into target directories. It features automatic filename transliteration, detailed JSONL operation logging, and a Tkinter-based GUI for pipeline monitoring, essential for managing large-scale infrastructure technical documentation.
pipeline-analytics.impact: Automates PDF routing and operation logging for engineering documentation flows.

portfolio-v2.title: AI-Powered PDF Search Engine
portfolio-v2.description: A semantic search and question-answering system for PDF documents. It utilizes RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) architecture and LLMs to extract context from a FAISS vector database, providing accurate, grounded answers based on uploaded technical documentation.
portfolio-v2.impact: Turns local technical PDFs into a searchable knowledge base with grounded answers.

graf-html.title: Interactive Trend Visualization
graf-html.description: A Python-based web application and toolkit (Dash/Plotly) for converting raw Excel/CSV data into interactive HTML plots. It enables engineers to quickly configure and analyze signals and trends, facilitating rapid pattern recognition in technical datasets without manual coding.
graf-html.impact: Converts Excel/CSV data into interactive engineering charts and trend views.
